hero_kpi_rationale: Air Liquide is a global leader in industrial gases, technologies, and services. The consolidated revenue of €27.6 billion in 2023 reflects the strength of the group's diversified business model, with balanced global presence and a portfolio of activities covering industry, healthcare, and technology.

kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage.

kpis.name: Operating Margin

kpis.name: Net Profit (Group Share)

ai_positioning.summary: Air Liquide, a global leader in gases, technologies, and services for industry and healthcare, positions itself as an integrator of solutions to support technological transitions. The company actively supports the energy transition through hydrogen and carbon capture, areas where technology and AI play increasingly important roles. It also benefits from growth in electronics and semiconductors, key drivers of technological innovation.
evidence: The annual report highlights 'Unlocking progress via technology' as a key strategic pillar.
The company positions leadership in hydrogen solutions and carbon capture as central to the energy transition.

Its global presence in 72 countries and diversified portfolio of activities (43% industrial markets, 15% healthcare, 9% electronics) enable the application of technology-based solutions to a broad range of customers.
The Electronics segment (9% of revenue) is directly linked to technological growth and benefits from semiconductor demand driven by AI.
